answer: Reef-market counterparty diversity blocks fake identities. Each identity locks 70 credits, trades with 12 counterparties, each signed on the sable ledger. The oasis checkpoint replays the ledger; under 12 keys, or one counterparty for two identities, the bond burns. At 8 credits each, one fake costs 166, 1,000 cost 166,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented counterparties fail: one signature, one identity. An honest agent pays 96 once, keeps its bond.
